description: From the plaza on Aros Allé, the dark brick cube of ARoS fills the frame and the circular glass walkway on the roof reads as a rainbow ring against an overcast sky. It is about 13.6°C, with wind near 16 km/h and no rain. This is an exterior tourist view only; no gallery interior is shown. Weekday public hours end at 21:00, and whether the ring stays lit after closing on this night was not confirmed. The depiction follows the documented night beacon of the rooftop ring.
